invariants.rationale: The method returns a non-null Pair as its result, barring unexpected implementation issues.
Partition path should not be null for clustering plans.
The list of file slices should be non-null at method exit, as it is passed as a parameter.
All elements in fileSlices should be non-null for correct clustering logic.
Pair returned should have both left (Stream<HoodieClusteringGroup>) and right (Boolean) non-null.
